blocks.content: Explore three panels with different fill opacity to see how the shading under a line changes.
Find **Lines** in the **Styles** row. Its fill opacity is 0, so there is no shading under the line.
Focus on **Fill opacity = 10**, further down. A faint shade sits under each line.
Focus on **Simple graph**, at the top. Its fill opacity is 40.
The shading is stronger, and where series overlap, one can hide another. The shading changes. The line positions don't. Darker fill doesn't mean a larger value.
You've compared three fill strengths. Fill opacity changes shading, not the values or the scale.
